prior_status: Exact GU tensorization was known for disjoint products (parity outer gate), but no B12 theorem handled arbitrary outer gates or the signed terminal/nonterminal activation ledger.
mathematical_delta: Proved U(g(h))=U(g)+sum_j Inf_j(g)U(h_j) for balanced disjoint children; proved for arbitrary outer g and parity block widths d_j that U is preserved, I=sum_j d_j Inf_j(g), and G=sum_{d_j=1} Delta_j U(g). This yields sharp K=0 when every block is nonterminal. Found an exact three-bit genuine-Boolean witness with signed deltas (1/2,-1/2,-1/2), refuting coordinatewise nonnegativity and monotonicity under parity inflation.
previous_bound: No recorded B12 GU bound for arbitrary outer gates under disjoint inner substitution.
new_bound: For arbitrary outer Boolean g with every inner parity block size at least two, G=0 exactly, so K=0 uniformly in all parameters.
remaining_obstacle: Generic balanced children become biased after physical restriction; the exact root chain rule does not include the signed biased-child defect, and individual Delta_i U terms cannot be assumed nonnegative.
next_action: Derive the exact two-branch biased-child upper-mass defect using the normalized-prior mixture, retain its signed coordinate ledger, and seek a source-influence/terminal-reserve payment that survives adaptive restriction.
